summary: Hood River County, Oregon, ODF lookout: 1931 tent camp, wooden tower and cabin by 1933-34, gone by 1945 or the 1950s. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 20-foot wooden L-4 tower with a log cabin

events.note: Tent camp with a phone (register). firelookout.com also gives 1931 for a camp.
Wooden tower and log cabin, per firelookout.com. The register dates the replacement to 1934.
Register says gone by 1945. firelookout.com says gone in the 1950s.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the tower's replacement of the camp to 1934 and firelookout.com to 1933. A photo captioned 1933 and a November 1933 panorama suggest a lookout stood on the site by 1933, which fits the firelookout.com date better.
The register and firelookout.com name the Oregon Department of Forestry; Forest Lookouts names the Mt Hood National Forest. The record's ODF entry is kept.

notes_for_editor: Removal is disputed: gone by 1945 (register) vs the 1950s (firelookout.com). A 1944 photo caption places the lookout on the site that year; the caption is not a photo of the tower we can see, so it is cited as a caption only. Agency conflict: Forest Lookouts says Mt Hood National Forest; the register and firelookout.com say ODF. Height is not recorded: firelookout.com gives 20 feet for the tower but does not say whether that runs to the cab floor, so it is kept in design, not height_m. No staffing, fire or access sources were found. The register's photos are credited but carry no licence, so none were added to photos.
